evidence_chain.link: Lipoprotein Lipase Deficiency is characterized by the absence of functional lipoprotein lipase activity, which is consistent with the absence of splenomegaly.

evidence_chain.link: Glycogen Storage Disease Type I is associated with hyperinsulinism, which is not directly related to the absence of splenomegaly.
